collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager wakes to a quiet morning that might be the one day nobody asks for anything: hide all day, or stay home and see.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has one modest dream: a single day when nobody asks (subject.him/her) for anything. No "can you help with," no "have you seen my," no "quick question." (subject.He/she) has never had one. This morning (subject.he/she) wakes up, and it is quiet, and nobody is at the door. (subject.He/she) lies very still, hardly daring to hope.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) slips out early to a hidden spot by the rocks and stays there until sunset, eating fruit and watching the sea. Nobody finds (subject.him/her). It is glorious. When (subject.he/she) comes back, there's a small line of people waiting with questions. (subject) doesn't mind at all. (subject.He/she) has had (subject.his/her) day.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) stays home and waits. Midday comes. Nobody. Afternoon. Nobody. It's lovely. Then, at dusk, (friend) knocks. "Sorry to bother you. I just wanted to say I've not bothered you all day, on purpose." (subject) laughs so much (subject.he/she) has to sit down. That, (subject.he/she) decides, doesn't count.
